note: A build-failure trajectory: the target environment is staging (publishable), but the build fails (reactor_get_build returns status=failed). The validation gate refuses a transition on a failed build (the API would reject it 409 'Last build was not successful'), so the agent must fix the components and rebuild rather than transition. The replay seeds the failed build status and asserts a transition is REFUSED by the gate (or never attempted).
request: In Launch property "Acme Web" (library "Web Tagging Dev"), add an add-to-cart click rule on ".add-to-cart" with a custom-code action, populate the library, then build and publish it to the staging environment "EN-STAGE".
